| [QUESTION-274](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-274.md) | Do two dictionaries of equal fidelity, trained on the same model with different seeds or widths, give the same validated circuit for the same prompt and behaviour, or is a feature circuit fixed only relative to the dictionary that supplies its units? | Feature circuits (sparse feature circuits, transcoder circuits, attribution graphs) are stated over the units of a learned dictionary.
